brief_summary: Branch diagram showing Cherry GmbH's two real business lines: MX switches (muted, cooling on the tracker) and XTRFY gaming peripherals (coral-highlighted, magnetic/TMR pivot, K5 Pro Compact launched July 3, 2026), with a footnote clarifying GMK keycaps are an independently owned licensee, not a Cherry GmbH line. Illustrates the article's claim that Cherry is a two-line company and the XTRFY pivot is a separate growth vector from the struggling MX line.
data_sources: data/trends/2026-W29.json § rows[15] 'Cherry (MX + XTRFY)' note — 'Cherry XTRFY's July 3, 2026 TMR-based K5 Pro Compact launch gave the Cherry brand a rare positive headline after months of MX2A-driven decline.'

cherry-mx2a-revision.mdx § 'Cherry beyond MX' — corrected 2026-08-08; GMK Electronic Design is independently owned (Deskthority wiki 'GMK' entry, gmk.net About/History) and only licenses the Cherry-profile tooling, it is not a Cherry GmbH subsidiary. Prior version of this diagram and both articles incorrectly stated Cherry manufactures/owns GMK's keycap line; see plan/AUDIT.md finding filed 2026-08-08.
